text:
lina: FYI ACME surfaced an ask during renewal — they want a 99.9% p99 latency SLA for hosted API + the ability to pin model v2. Sales wants a commitment this quarter (Q2). Thoughts?

sam: they said they'd expand usage if we can guarantee it. sounds like renewal hinge. :thinking_face:

derek: 99.9% p99 is nontrivial. that implies dedicated capacity or strict throttles. Hosted as-is won't meet that consistently.

maria: model pinning is doable only on Dedicated/Private. hosted supports versioning but not firm pin guarantees.

lina: options on the table: (A) push an infra sprint to try and hit p99 on hosted (B) offer a temporary canary + credits (C) Dedicated pilot with SLA and model pinning (D) negotiate scope (lower p99 / phased SLA).

derek: quick RICE style note: Reach=1 account, Impact=9 for product, Confidence~0.6, Effort =~ 3 teams * 6w => overall score looks low vs platform projects already queued.

sam: ACME is ~1.2M ARR. Sales says churn risk is high if we don't commit.

lina: Sam, can you confirm churn risk / legal ask details (penalties, term)? we need concrete numbers to prioritize.

sam: legal asked for a 12mo SLA with financial credits. ACME pushed hard in last call; will escalate to VP if we stall.

maria: practical compromise: 95% p99 on hosted + Dedicated trial for 90 days with pinning. define acceptance criteria (p99 test harness, traffic profile).

derek: we can stand up a Dedicated pilot, but capacity reservation cost is non-trivial and autoscale behaviour + eviction policies need review. ops needs an estimate.

lina: proposed decision: go with option C (Dedicated pilot) + negotiated SLA terms (timeboxed, capped credits, exit clause). we draft a short spec and RICE justification to hand to execs.

sam: OK I'll push that in the renewal call and try to get a 6-week delivery window.

deploy-bot: heads up — infra maintenance 2025-06-02 02:00 UTC, possible transient latency during rollout.

lina: thanks. I'll write the spec: include rollout steps, success metrics (p99 target, error budget burn rate, smoke tests), rollback criteria, and estimated cost. pinging @derek and @maria for numbers by EOD. :thumbsup:

derek: will calc effort + cost and drop numbers in the doc.

maria: I'll draft the acceptance checklist and monitoring queries for the eval harness.

lina: cool. if legal/finance wants stricter terms we'll re-evaluate priority using RICE + ARR impact. keep comments here so I can fold into the spec.
